verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a built-in Aleph Agent that can update reports and dashboards through Slack and natural-language prompts, plus generic mentions of versioned forecasts and audit logs. None of it documents a machine interface (API, OpenAPI, or MCP) that lets an agent build or update a forecast or scenario, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Nothing ties agent-made changes to the same audit trail as human edits, so the related features are adjacent and earn no credit here.
